issues.where: night-side limb, lower right (crops E, H, R in image-02/03)
issues.what: the dark limb has a doubled edge: a thin bright rim sits a few pixels inside a second dark rim, like a shadow disc laid over the globe and slightly misaligned
issues.fix: drop the separate night overlay or match its radius exactly to the globe and blend its edge into the atmosphere falloff

issues.where: night-side limb, right and lower right (crops E, H, Q in image-06/07, U in image-08)
issues.what: same doubled ring on the dark limb, more visible here as a grey arc separated from the globe edge
issues.fix: align the shadow layer with the sphere and let the rim light fade continuously into the terminator

issues.where: upper right limb, aurora (crop C in image-02, L/M in image-03)
issues.what: the aurora is a row of repeated, evenly spaced green comb strokes pasted on the limb, with a flat red smudge behind it; reads as a sticker layer rather than light in the atmosphere
issues.fix: vary the curtain spacing, height and brightness, follow the limb curvature, and blend the red upper fringe into a soft gradient

issues.where: upper right limb, aurora (crop C in image-06, K/L in image-07)
issues.what: same repeated comb-like aurora strokes with a hard inner edge on the limb
issues.fix: use varied, translucent curtains with soft falloff and less regular spacing

issues.what: cloud texture near the limb smears into streaky, stretched striations with oversharpened white fringes
issues.fix: use higher-resolution cloud texture near the limb and reduce sharpening

issues.where: land surfaces, North and South America (crops A, G, H)
issues.what: terrain looks airbrushed and oversharpened, with uniform halo-like bright coastlines and painted mountain ridges
issues.fix: reduce local contrast and edge sharpening, add finer natural variation to land texture

issues.what: the globe and its atmosphere are cut off by the frame at top and bottom, so the limb glow ends abruptly at the border
issues.fix: scale the globe down or reframe so the full limb and glow fit inside the frame

issues.where: night side, eastern South America (crop H)
issues.what: city lights are uniform round dots of similar size and brightness, scattered like a pattern
issues.fix: vary light size and intensity and cluster them along coasts and road networks

issues.where: right and lower-right night-side limb (image-14.png crops C, E, H, I; image-15.png crop R; image-16.png crop V)
issues.what: a dark gap and sharp thin outer shell create a clear doubled edge along the shadowed limb inside a faint outer haze
issues.fix: remove the detached outer shell line so the night-side limb transitions smoothly and continuously into a single atmospheric falloff

issues.where: dense starfield and Milky Way band behind the upper-left and bottom limb (image-14.png crops G, H; image-15.png crop K; image-16.png crops U, V)
issues.what: stars in the dense galactic band are blurry, smeared blobs and blocky low-resolution patches rather than crisp point sources
issues.fix: render stars at native resolution with sub-pixel anti-aliased point sources and clean, high-resolution galactic dust/starfield detail

issues.where: Moon in upper right sky (image-15.png crop M)
issues.what: lunar maria and craters look soft and airbrushed at native scale, and the sunlit left edge has a jagged, stepped bright rim
issues.fix: use a sharp native-resolution lunar surface map with crisp terminator crater relief and clean anti-aliasing along the lit limb

issues.where: South America night side and aurora-lit northern night region (image-14.png crops C, E, H; image-15.png crop Q)
issues.what: city lights appear as oversized soft yellow blobs with blocky pixel halos and isolated square bright dots under the aurora
issues.fix: replace blobby light spots with fine-scale coastal and inland urban light networks properly attenuated by atmosphere and clouds

issues.where: North American terrain, Pacific cyclone clouds, and sunlit left limb (image-14.png crops F, G; image-15.png crop P; image-16.png crop U)
issues.what: landmasses and cloud tops mix painterly smoothing with crunchy pixelation at 1:1 scale, and the left limb clips into a bright halo band
issues.fix: render higher-resolution albedo and cloud displacement textures without sharpening artifacts and soften the bright-side Rayleigh rim

issues.where: upper sky gradient above the limb and cloud over Florida's east coast (image-10.png crops B, C; image-11.png crops K, L, Q, R)
issues.what: subtle tonal stepping appears in the dark blue-to-black sky and top-edge flare haze, with a faint chromatic smudge under a coastal cloud in crop Q
issues.fix: dither the upper atmospheric and flare gradient at higher bit depth and clean up the localized color artifact on the Florida coastline
